mapper.insert: insert into ai_call_log (dish_id, call_type, model_name, success, cost_ms, error_msg, raw_content, create_time) values (#{dishId}, #{callType}, #{modelName}, #{success}, #{costMs}, #{errorMsg}, #{rawContent}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select case success when 1 then '调用成功' else '调用失败' end name, count(*) value from ai_call_log group by success
